messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime-service pod runtime-xyz on gpu-node-17 restarted 3x in 5m due to OOM during prefill (CUDA OOM). Auto-pager triggered.
maya: I'm on it. Marking pager. Any customer-facing impact known?
javier: Logs show CUDA out-of-memory in the prefill stage. Repro on a /generate request with a ~200k-token history from tenant AcmeFlow.
ops-eng: Can you paste the CUDA backtrace and the prefill stack snippet?
javier: Here's the relevant excerpt:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.1 GiB (GPU 0; 16.00 GiB total, 12.3 GiB already allocated)
  File "/app/runtime/prefill.py", line 242, in allocate_kv
    kv = model.allocate_kv(len(history_tokens))
```
We also see KV cache grow linearly with repeated system messages; prefills are >3x normal size.
sara: AcmeFlow CS pinged earlier about slow responses. They're likely impacted. I'll open a support incident.
deploy-bot: Rolling a traffic split to fallback-model-q4 (quantized smaller KV) for runtime-service -> 30% now.
ops-eng: Good. Also let's cordon and drain gpu-node-17 to avoid noisy neighbor restarts. maya, can you approve a node rotation?
maya: Approve. Execute drain and rotate.
ops-eng: Running drain now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=5m
```
kate: Hotpool rotated, pods recreated on gpu-node-23 and gpu-node-5. Monitoring memory.
javier: After traffic split + node drain, OOMs stopped. KV cache trimming patch queued: enable prefix-trim heuristics and hard cap on history tokens per tenant.
sara: Notifying AcmeFlow: sent email and live message that we're mitigating; asking them to throttle long-history exports.
cust-success: AcmeFlow replied — they were running a backfill ingestion that concatenated many sessions. They paused it.
maya: Handing off to javier for post-incident follow-up and CS sync. Please confirm scope and next steps.
javier: Will create postmortem ticket and propose a temporary tenant cap + runtime guardrail and a permanent KV trim fix.
ops-eng: Suggest adding a per-tenant prefill token limit and an alert for unusual KV growth rates.
maya: :white_check_mark: Thanks team. I'll close pager when monitoring stable for 15m.
incident-bot: Pager silence scheduled. Next check at +15m.
